| F1.32 | OPS | normal | Q-OPS-02@CON-001 | What does the agent do when Microsoft 365 is slow or returns partial data, and how long does it wait? | "If Microsoft 365 is down, there is no note that morning." in [[desktop-agent-runtime]] |
| F1.33 | OPS | normal | Q-OPS-02@CON-002 | After how many seconds does the agent give up on the Summariser for a 7:30 digest, and for a prep note due ten minutes before a meeting? | "How long counts as slow is not yet defined" in [[summariser-runtime]] |
| F1.34 | OPS | normal | Q-OPS-02@CON-003 | What does the agent do when the consent check is slow, and may it ever rely on an earlier answer? | "If it is down, or the sign-in fails, it answers no, and the Desktop agent reads nothing." in [[consent-and-identity-runtime]] |
| F1.35 | OPS | high | Q-OPS-02@CON-004 | What happens to a switch-on or switch-off when Consent and identity cannot be reached, and how is the record kept right? | "The person switches the Desktop agent off, and the agent tells Consent and identity, so later consent checks answer no." in [[FLO-004-withdraw-consent]] |
| F1.36 | OPS | normal | Q-OPS-02@CON-005 | What does Consent and identity do when Microsoft sign-in is slow or down, and who tells the agent's users? | "Not recorded. Microsoft runs the interface, and no agreement with Microsoft is registered." in [[consent-and-identity-building-blocks]] |
| F1.37 | OPS | normal | Q-OPS-03@CAP-001 | Which team owns reading calendar entries and transcripts once the project hands off, and who agrees contract changes in the meantime? | "Builds at handoff: @agent-lead's team, by the solution lead's word; a Grill decides it." in [[concern-ownership]] |
| F1.38 | OPS | normal | Q-OPS-03@CAP-002 | Which team owns the digest and prep note display, including a note that fails to show? | "Builds at handoff: @agent-lead's team, by the solution lead's word; a Grill decides it." in [[concern-ownership]] |
| F1.39 | OPS | normal | Q-OPS-03@CAP-003 | Which team owns and builds the digest writer under each answer to the text call? | "Product owner owns it; who builds it depends on where" in [[concern-ownership]] |
| F1.40 | OPS | normal | Q-OPS-03@CAP-004 | Which team owns the prep note writer, and who is on the hook when a prep note is wrong? | "Product owner owns it; who builds it depends on where" in [[concern-ownership]] |
| F1.41 | OPS | high | Q-OPS-03@CAP-005 | Which team builds and runs the consent record, and has the identity team been asked? | "Nobody has said which team builds Consent and identity." in [[11-unknowns-and-risks]] |
| F1.42 | OPS | high | Q-OPS-03@CAP-006 | Which team owns the consent check answer and its availability? | "Nobody has said which team builds Consent and identity." in [[11-unknowns-and-risks]] |
